_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no momentum, funding, or fear_greed breaker has appeared, so the statistically honest call is continued Anxiety range rather than a forced slide or lift.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Anxiety; narrative offers no distinct forward direction so analyst HOLD stands
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds the range with fear_greed stuck in the 30s and funding pinned near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed breaks under ~25 with momentum leaving mid-range (down toward Denial), or ETF flows plus momentum lift the score into Complacency
